service_enabled.description: Whether to start the QAT daemon automatically on boot.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 (error) to 4 (trace). Set to 2 (info) for normal operation.

max_instances.description: Maximum number of QAT instances (devices) the daemon will manage. Must match hardware capabilities.

device_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for device initialization and shutdown. Increase if devices fail to come up reliably.

auto_load_firmware.description: If supported, automatically load firmware to QAT devices at startup. Disable only if firmware is preloaded.

firmware_path.description: Optional custom path to firmware images. If empty, default locations are used.

pci_devices.description: List of PCI devices (in BDF format) to be managed by this daemon. Leave empty to auto-discover all QAT devices.

instances.description: List of QAT instance configurations. Each instance corresponds to a set of work queues and workers.

type.description: Instance type label (e.g., 'typical', 'high_throughput', 'low_latency'). Not used by daemon directly; for reference only.

num_vfs.description: Number of PCI virtual functions (VFs) to allocate for this instance. Set to 0 to use PF directly.

shm_enabled.description: Enable shared memory interface for inter-process communication (requires user-space driver support).

shm_size.description: Size of shared memory region (in MiB) per instance. Only applicable if shm_enabled is true.

num_work_queues.description: Number of work queues to create for this instance.

queue_types.description: Types of queues to instantiate: 'sym' (symmetric crypto), 'asym' (asymmetric crypto), 'compress' (compression), 'deflate' (deflate), 'dsa' (data streaming acceleration), etc.

worker_affinity.description: CPU core(s) to bind worker threads (e.g., 'auto', '0,1', '0x3'). Use 'auto' for automatic balancing.

poll_mode.description: Use polling (low-latency, high-CPU) instead of interrupt-driven mode. Recommended only for deterministic low-latency use cases.

max_pending_requests.description: Maximum number of pending requests per work queue. Increase under high concurrency, reduce to lower memory usage.

compress_enabled.description: Enable hardware-accelerated compression for compress/deflate queues. Has no effect for non-compression queue types.
